```{r}
# load dataset into environment
claims <- read_csv("victimhood_claims.csv") %>%
  rowid_to_column() %>%
  mutate(Ingroup = Ingroup != "0" & Ingroup != "103",
         Injustice = Injustice != 0)
```

```{r}
# get bigrams
bigrams <- claims$Narrative %>%
  textstat_collocations(
    size = 2,
    min_count = 5
  )

# get top10 values
top10_count <- bigrams %>%
  arrange(desc(count)) %>%
  slice(1:10)

top10_lambda <- bigrams %>%
  arrange(desc(lambda)) %>%
  slice(1:10)

top10_z <- bigrams %>%
  arrange(desc(z)) %>%
  slice(1:10)

# print values
top10_count$collocation
top10_lambda$collocation
top10_z$collocation
```

```{r}
# tokenize
tokens <- claims$Narrative %>%
  tokens(remove_punct = TRUE,
         split_hyphens = TRUE,
         verbose = TRUE)

# create dfm
dfm_claims <- dfm(tokens)

# trim dfm
dfm_claims_1pct <- dfm_claims %>%
  dfm_trim(
    min_docfreq = 0.01,
    docfreq_type = "prop"
  )

dfm_claims_5pct <- dfm_claims %>%
  dfm_trim(
    min_docfreq = 0.05,
    docfreq_type = "prop"
  )

dfm_claims_10pct <- dfm_claims %>%
  dfm_trim(
    min_docfreq = 0.1,
    docfreq_type = "prop"
  )

dfm_claims_15pct <- dfm_claims %>%
  dfm_trim(
    min_docfreq = 0.15,
    docfreq_type = "prop"
  )

# get sparsity
sparsity_table <- data.frame(
  category = c(
    "1%",
    "5%",
    "10%",
    "15%"
  ),
  value = c(
    sparsity(dfm_claims_1pct),
    sparsity(dfm_claims_5pct),
    sparsity(dfm_claims_10pct),
    sparsity(dfm_claims_15pct)
  )
)
```

```{r}
# create chart
sparsity_chart <- sparsity_table %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(x = reorder(category, -value),
        y= value)
  ) + 
  geom_col() + 
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0,1),
    labels = scales::percent
  ) + 
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Percentage"
  ) + 
  theme_minimal()

sparsity_chart
```

```{r}

# fix pseudo random number generator
set.seed(17091826)

# split data
train_ids <- claims %>%
  mutate(id = row_number()) %>%
  slice_sample(prop = 0.8) %>%
  pull(id)

test_ids <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(claims)), train_ids)

train_dfm <- dfm_claims_15pct[train_ids, ]
test_dfm  <- dfm_claims_15pct[test_ids, ]

y_train <- claims$Ingroup[train_ids]
y_test  <- claims$Ingroup[test_ids]

# train naive bayes
naive_bayes <- textmodel_nb(
  x = train_dfm, # X_train
  y = y_train,
  prior = "docfreq"
)

# validate
predictions <- predict(
  naive_bayes,
  newdata = test_dfm, # X_test
  type = "class"
)

# get metrics
confusionMatrix(
  predictions,
  as.factor(y_test)
)
```

```{r}
# load fbposts into environment
fbposts_filtered <- fbposts %>%
  filter(n_pictures == 1)

#get intercoder reliability
reliability <- fbposts_filtered %>%
  test_icr(unit_var = post_id,
           coder_var = coder_id,
           holsti = FALSE,
           agreement = FALSE,
           kripp_alpha = TRUE,
           fleiss_kappa = TRUE,
           brennan_prediger = TRUE,
           na.omit = TRUE)

reliability
```
